Name: Neural Harvest
Author: acidyq
Description:
[b]Neural Harvest[/b] revolutionizes character interaction in Stardew Valley by generating dynamic, contextually-aware dialogue for NPCs using advanced AI technology. Say goodbye to repetitive conversations and discover a more immersive Pelican Town where villagers feel truly alive, responding uniquely based on your relationship, the season, weather conditions, and even remembering your past interactions.
Why Neural Harvest?
Tired of hearing the same dialogue from Shane after 200 hours of gameplay? Wish Leah would acknowledge your farm's growth over the seasons? Neural Harvest solves these problems by creating unique, personalized dialogue that evolves as your game progresses.
Key Features
🧠 Advanced AI Dialogue Generation
[list]
[*]Real-time dialogue generation powered by state-of-the-art language models
[*]Each character has a unique personality profile, interests, and speech patterns
[*]Responses adapt to your relationship level, weather, season, and time of day
[*]Special contextual dialogue for festivals, birthdays, and important game events
[*]Use your own OpenAI API key for unlimited, high-quality conversations
[/list]💬 Memory System
[list]
[*]NPCs remember your past conversations and reference them later
[*]Characters acknowledge important milestones in your relationship
[*]Dialogue evolves as your friendship grows, reflecting your shared history
[*]Multiple dialogue paths based on player choices and farm development
[/list]👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Complete Character Coverage
[list]
[*]All 22 base game villagers supported with unique profiles
[*]Bachelors/bachelorettes with special romance dialogue
[*]Family members with realistic relationship dynamics
[*]Community figures with town-focused interactions
[/list]🖥️ Web Dashboard
[list]
[*]Monitor dialogue history for all characters
[*]Test dialogue generation with different parameters
[*]Customize settings including API key configuration
[*]View stats and system status
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*][b]Requirements[/b]:
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.5.6 or higher
[*]SMAPI 3.18.0 or higher
[*]Python 3.8+ (for running the dialogue server)
[/list]
[*][b]Using Vortex (Recommended)[/b]:
[list]
[*]Download and install with Vortex mod manager
[*]Follow the FOMOD installer prompts
[*]Start the dialogue server before launching the game
[/list]
[*][b]Manual Installation[/b]:
[list]
[*]Extract to your Stardew Valley Mods folder
[*]Start the Python server (see documentation)
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI
[/list]
[/list]Operation Modes
[list]
[*][b]Full AI Mode[/b]: Connect to OpenAI API for unlimited unique dialogue (requires API key)
[*][b]Fallback Mode[/b]: Use pre-generated dialogue when offline or without an API key
[*][b]Mixed Mode[/b]: Prioritize AI for important dialogues, use fallback for casual interactions
[/list]Compatibility
[list]
[*]Compatible with most content mods
[*]Works with custom NPCs that follow Stardew's dialogue format
[*]Safe to add or remove mid-save
[/list]Future Updates
[list]
[*]Additional character support for modded NPCs
[*]Expanded contextual awareness for farm development and achievements
[*]More configuration options for dialogue style and content
[/list]Support
[list]
[*]Join our Discord community for help and discussions
[*]Report issues on our GitHub repository
[*]Check the included documentation for detailed setup instructions
[/list]Experience Stardew Valley like never before with AI-powered conversations that make every villager feel like a real friend!
